invariant_bindings.invariant_text: `get(name, version)` MUST invoke the loader at most once per name:version pair across the registry's lifetime (memoisation).
`get()` on an unregistered name:version MUST raise KeyError — fail-loud, no silent None return, no implicit registration.
`register()` with `version` defaulting to 'latest' MUST be the logical identifier for unversioned callers; two distinct version strings under the same name MUST coexist as independent cache slots.
